description: Land Acquisition - Deraniyagala South, Deraniyagala D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of the land lots, their boundaries, and exact locations. While it mentions a government minister, the core content focuses entirely on land/property matters rather than government structure or personnel changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
